review_candidates.title: Video Conferencing Engineer
review_candidates.description: Summary Provide support for enterprise Video Conferencing and Audio-Visual collaboration environments, including Zoom Rooms, Microsoft Teams Rooms, Cisco Collaboration, Poly endpoints, Q-SYS, Crestron, and Extron solutions. Responsible for troubleshooting AV/VC issues, meeting room operations, VIP/VVIP support, incident and change management, preventive maintenance, monitoring, RCA, documentation, and automation to ensure high availability and seamless collaboration services in a 24x7 support environment. Responsibilities Provide support for Zoom Rooms, Cisco Video Conferencing, and Microsoft Teams Rooms. Troubleshoot audio, video, content sharing, camera, microphone, codec, and connectivity issues. Support Poly Studio X52, X72, G7500, and G62 endpoints. Manage and support Crestron, Extron, and Q-SYS integrated AV solutions. Perform room commissioning, firmware upgrades, preventive maintenance, and health checks. Monitor meeting room infrastructure and proactively resolve service-impacting issues. Support VIP/VVIP meetings and business-critical events. Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and implement corrective actions. Manage incidents, service requests, changes, and problem tickets within SLA targets. Maintain operational documentation, SOPs, runbooks, knowledge articles, and inventory records. Coordinate with vendors and stakeholders for issue resolution and service improvements. Develop and maintain automation solutions using PowerShell, Python, or Shell scripting. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Electronics, Telecommunications, or a related technical discipline. Minimum 4 years of experience in Video Conferencing, Unified Communications, and Audio-Visual support environments. Experience supporting enterprise collaboration platforms and executive-level stakeholders. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, communication, and documentation skills. Experience working in ITIL-based support environments. 24x7 shift-based support, on-call rotation, and major incident management.
